verdict.rationale: Runloop offers a CLI (rli) and API-driven Devboxes that can be scripted for provisioning, running agents, and benchmarking without a UI, including a documented benchmark job command that automates provisioning, running, scoring, and aggregation — a clear headless/CI workflow. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), CI-specific auth/token docs, and independent confirmation of headless use in production pipelines.
